description: Respond to a buyer's quote request (seller tool)

action.description: accept the buyer's terms as asked, counter with a different price (requires counter_price), or decline the request.

counter_price.description: Counter offer price in cents (for counter action)

message.description: Optional note sent to the buyer alongside the decision.

quote_request_id.description: Id of the quote request to answer, as returned by get_quote_requests.

name: respond_to_quote
title: Respond to a quote request
